title: Book's claim of alien contact at Bentwaters, disputed by witnesses
summary: James Fox tells of Book's claim of alien contact at Bentwaters, disputed by witnesses, about 1980 at RAF Bentwaters, England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: about that there was actual contact with aliens at bent wers in 1980

plain: A UFO investigator and filmmaker, James Fox, talks about a book called Left at East Gate, which claims there was actual contact with aliens in 1980 at Bentwaters, an air base in England. Fox says the men who were there, including Charles Halt, Jim Penniston and John Burroughs, dispute that claim. It matters because, if true, it would be a case of face-to-face contact at a military base.
